decision: Select the unchanged c5c dense A0 same-host control retry after the r1 pre-step disk incident. It is a control, not a quality claim; run once only after final independent request review and fresh host gates.
selection_rationale: A valid c5c control on trn22 is needed before A2 tables can be judged. The r1 attempt had zero optimizer boundaries and no score. Human-expanded storage, a human-acknowledged breaker reset, an isolated clean source stage, host-specific G1 calibration and the exact-environment four-rank CPU G2 have now passed their respective independent checks.
immutable_science: The exact full-chip LNC2 x four-rank seed-42, max-1800-second command and six retained warm-cache paths in the independently reviewed staged request; no model or evaluator edit.
six_warm_cache_paths: Bound exactly by staged_request_sha256; no cold fallback, cache cleanup or path substitution
abort_conditions: Any protected source, prepare.py, train argv, effective environment, cache or checkpoint identity drift
Any STOP or breaker, dirty or occupied host, Neuron/device/lock holder, reused label, or missing external observer
Root free bytes below 10737418240 immediately before launch or approaching the 6979321856-byte operational floor during compile/training
Any timeout, crash, NaN, missing sequential boundary, nonfinite checkpoint, budget or causality failure
remaining_before_dispatch: Materialize an exact top-level one-shot request from the staged template and independently review its SHA-256 with this ratification bound
Immediately before launch, recheck source, caches, checkpoint, host idle/device/lock/STOP/breakers, unique label, at least 10 GiB free and the external boundary observer
Issue a separate one-label Supervisor authorization bound to the final reviewed request and fresh preflight; an Operator alone dispatches once
